authority: READ_ONLY_ADVISORY: scripts/lib/model_chooser.py reads this matrix; it changes no lane by itself. The Model Scout never writes it.
rule: A task class maps to an ordered chain of logical steps. An anthropic step names a TIER (bulk / mid / standard), never a raw model id; the tier resolves to a model through config/anthropic_credit_policy.json models (tier_model_source below). A deepseek step names a logical policy from config/llm_model_registry.json logical_policies. Upgrading a model is a one-line tier change plus an eval, not a code change.

tier_model_source.note: The design names the model registry as the home of tier -> model; today the live mapping is the credit policy's models block, which AnthropicTransport already reads. Keeping one source: the chooser resolves from there. Moving it is a lead decision.

step_kinds.anthropic: provider anthropic, field tier (bulk | mid | standard)
step_kinds.deepseek: provider deepseek, field policy (a logical_policies key); offpeak_only true means use only outside pricing_peak_hours_utc
step_kinds.grok: provider grok (subscription lane); decommissioning true means the step is dropped at the Grok decommission (design §4 step 5)

verdict.label: high-stakes verdict
verdict.fail_closed_note: No third step: when both Anthropic tiers are unavailable the call fails closed and alerts (design §3C).

eval_classes_note: The Model Scout evaluates candidates on these six (design §5.2 step 4); diagnose shares the mid tier with reason and critique and has no separate set.
